page.layout: One page of running text, with running head at top and page number at top right. Below the text: a centred two-line heading, then a paragraph opening with a large initial. Signature at bottom centre and catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: tores à Quæstore censuum, monastico-rum, uti est decreto Ordinum statutum; de qua quotannis mense Februario in Camera rationum præsentibus Ordinum delectis calculum ponere coguntur. Voluntatem horum exactor exequitur: & rationes menstruas de iis, quæ ejus curæ commissa sunt, apud hos eosdem reddit. Et licet etiam curatoribus adsciscerè sibi matronas duas honestas rei œconomicæ peritas, quæ partem curarum & inspectionis in se recipiant, sed gratuitò similiter, ut ipsi curatores. Hoc ἐργαστή-ριον[?] multis malis terrori, multis etiam emendationi est, à disciplina & coërcitione nuncupatum.
main_text.head: DE ACADEMIA GRONINGÆ NUPER INSTITUTA.
main_text.p: CORONIS mihi esto hujus libelli recogniti Academia in hac urbe ab Ordinibus provinciæ studio procerum eruditorum anno superiore M.DC.XIV instituta, & solen-

page.notes: The Greek word broken at the line end ("ἐργαστή-" / "ριον") is my reading from context (ergasterion, a house of correction); the letters are partly unclear, so the whole word is marked [?]. The large initial C of "CORONIS" is joined to the word as the drop cap. The faint "Digitized by Google" stamp at lower right is excluded.
